objective: Establish what rune (https://github.com/anomalyco/rune) is and how to build an application like a Windows disk-health terminal dashboard with it.
scope: The repository https://github.com/anomalyco/rune: README, docs, examples, source layout, language/runtime, package name and latest version or commit, license, platform support (Windows especially), how input (keyboard, mouse), layout, styling, state/reactivity, async/timers and rendering work

Whether rune is a TUI framework, a language, or something else; and how an existing Rust app (Windows IOCTL/SMART backend via windows-sys, serde_json history) could be rewritten on it: can the Windows backend stay in Rust, must it move to another language, or does rune offer FFI/native access
How to install/build/test a rune project, and whether it can run/build on Linux CI and produce Windows binaries
constraints: Read-only research; cite URLs and file paths for every fact and separate sourced facts from inference

Report in under 700 words; put longer notes (API cheat sheet with code snippets of a minimal app: layout, keyboard+mouse handling, timers, list/tabs, scrolling) in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-chkdsk/6d301693-1f05-56b7-955a-cbe3996284b5/scratchpad/rune-notes.md and give its path
